profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks
profile.summary: With over five years of work experience in software engineering, I am passionate about creating innovative and secure solutions for web and mobile applications. I currently work as a software engineer at Venafi, a leader in machine identity management, where I use java, go, and react to develop and maintain features for the company's cloud platform. I also founded Bodistics, a startup that provides fitness and wellness tracking and coaching through a mobile app, where I oversee the product development, design, and marketing. I am driven by the mission of creating value for users and customers, and I enjoy collaborating with diverse and talented teams to deliver high-quality products and services.

projects.title: JustOneMore
projects.description: JustOneMore is an innovative app designed to deepen the bond between you and your little ones through the timeless art of storytelling. This app enables you to capture the essence of bedtime tales by recording your own voice reading their favorite stories. You can then send these personalized, enchanting narrations to create a magical experience for your children, just in time for their bedtime. It's more than just a story; it's a memorable moment shared, even when you can't be there in person

projects.title: Bodistics
projects.description: Bodistics is a meticulously designed document-based application tailored to assist nutritionists and dietitians in streamlining the process of meal plan creation. This user-friendly app simplifies the task of designing customized meal plans, allowing professionals to focus more on their clients' unique dietary needs. With its seamless sharing capabilities, Bodistics ensures that these personalized meal plans can be effortlessly shared with clients, enhancing communication and improving client satisfaction in their nutritional journey.
